playAria.where: Recording player: screen-reader label of the play button
playAria.context: {title} is the take's title, e.g. 'Shir Shabbat, Nov 14, 2025'.

pauseAria.where: Recording player: screen-reader label of the pause button

seekAria.where: Recording player: screen-reader label of the position slider

playFailed.where: Recording player: shown in place of the slider when the file will not play

otherTakes.where: Recording popover: summary of the collapsed list of other takes
otherTakes.context: {count} is how many other takes the song has.

showThisTake.where: Recording popover: button on a take, makes it the take everyone sees

showThisTakeFailed.where: Recording popover: error under the takes when showing a take fails

libraryListenAria.where: Library row: screen-reader label of the music note button that opens the player

listen.where: Setlist list and editor: the Listen link text (editor header button, list menu item)
listen.context: Opens a quiet page that plays each song's recording; not the performance view.

listenAria.where: Setlist list and editor: screen-reader label of the Listen link

noRecordingYet.where: Listen page: muted line on a song with no playable recording

listenIntro.where: Listen page: one line under the setlist name

listenEmpty.where: Listen page: shown when the setlist has no songs
